about: Hand-written reading questions. Each one needs: id, lesson, shape ('choice' or 'order'). A choice question has instruction, optional passage / sentence / text, options (list) and answer (the position of the right option, counting from 0), plus explain {hanzi, pinyin, english} shown after answering. Set hanziOptions to true when the options are Chinese. These were written by Claude from HSK 1 words; they are not copied from the exercise book.

questions.passage: 我叫王方，我是中国人。我是老师。
我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、我和我女儿。我女儿今年六岁了。

explain.pinyin: Wǒ nǚ'ér jīnnián liù suì le.
explain.english: My daughter is six this year.

questions.instruction: Choose the best answer to the question

questions.passage: 我想喝茶。这个杯子多少钱？二十八块。
questions.text: What does the speaker want to do?

questions.instruction: Choose the best answer to the question

questions.passage: 现在是上午十点。我们下午三点去看电影。
questions.text: When will they watch the film?

explain.hanzi: 我们下午三点去看电影。
explain.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sān diǎn qù kàn diànyǐng.
explain.english: We're going to see a film at three in the afternoon.

questions.passage: 昨天北京的天气怎么样？昨天下雨了，很冷。
questions.text: What was the weather like in Beijing yesterday?

explain.pinyin: Zuótiān xià yǔ le, hěn lěng.
explain.english: It rained yesterday and it was cold.

explain.hanzi: 我昨天买了一点儿水果。
explain.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān mǎi le yìdiǎnr shuǐguǒ.
